- Bank details: Please use the EUR account on the invoice (see attached).

- Citrine disputes one line (Dec 15 professional services, 8 hours) — they claim it was a change order and want it clarified whether it's billable under existing SOW.
- They requested SWIFT/IBAN confirmation (we provided bank details but treasury often wants a formatted wire).

My recommended next steps (quick wins):
1) Issue a short VAT confirmation email that they can retain for audit (2–3 sentences + reference to the invoice & VAT ID).
2) Pull the vendor validation packet (KYC/VAT docs) from onboarding and redline any PII before sharing.
3) Ask the engagement PM (Rishi) to confirm whether the Dec 15 hours were within scope or a change order; if change order, prepare a credit note or revised invoice.
4) Prepare a formal past-due notice to be sent if full payment hasn't arrived by 2027-01-28 (per contract we're allowed to levy 10% late fee after 30 days).

Can Monica take point on the past-due notice template and send to Citrine on my signal? Markus — do you want to join the proposed exec touchpoint if this slips?
